name: ilo-rad-suite
description: A comprehensive DICOM Radiograph viewer suite for ILO standard classification.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix viewer-app && npm install --prefix bviewer-app && npm install --prefix pusher-app
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix viewer-app && npm run build --prefix bviewer-app && npm run build --prefix pusher-app
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix viewer-app" "npm start --prefix bviewer-app" "npm start --prefix pusher-app"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix viewer-app" "npm run dev --prefix bviewer-app" "npm run dev --prefix pusher-app"
